newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai sells 25 pct of new stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai sells 25 pct of new stock exchange.

text.p: The new Shanghai stock exchange building in the Pudong New Area has sold 3,000 square metres or 25 percent of its saleable floor area, the Shanghai Securities Newspaper said on Friday.
The building has a total floor area of 100,000 square metres, of which it is selling 12 percent, the newspaper said.

The building is charging $2,700 per square metre, the highest price in the Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone, which the Shanghai city government wants to turn into its new financial centre, the newspaper said.
Securities companies from South Korea and Hong Kong are the first buyers of space in the building, it said.
The Shanghai Stock Exchange is to move in July 1997 to the new building.
